import Mathlib
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_d_frobenius (m n a b : ℕ) (h : Nat.Coprime m n) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : m * a + n * b ≠ m * n := by
  simpa only [mul_comm m a, mul_comm n b] using h.mul_add_mul_ne_mul ha hb
